name: BOSS
description: BOSS is a benchmark suite for evaluating out-of-distribution robustness in NLP, covering 5 tasks and 20 datasets with challenging distribution shifts. It enables analysis of model performance on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution data, facilitating evaluation of robustness and adaptation methods for pre-trained language models and LLMs.
reputation: A recent benchmark suite for OOD robustness in NLP that is gaining attention in the robustness community but is not yet a long-established standard.
notes: Focuses on challenging distribution shifts and includes evaluation of classic methods and LLM adaptation paradigms.
